eventDetail.scope: The Conference Program will feature high-profile plenary and keynote speakers, complemented by a diverse range of workshops, mini-symposia, and scientific sessions. The technical program will include both oral and poster presentations. An exhibition hall will bring together industry leaders and academic institutions. Dedicated activities will also support students, young professionals, and Women in Engineering, fostering networking, collaboration, and professional development.
